scenes.script: The town of Velmora started its first night bus service on Monday, the town council says.
Buses now run on 3 routes from the harbour to the hills, until 2 in the morning.
The council says a bus comes every 20 minutes, and a ticket costs the same as in the day.
The plan has three parts. A test until June, then a public review, and a council vote in September.
Drivers told the local paper that the first night was quiet. The review opens in June.
